description: CMR 2018 - Communications Industry Overview: Telecommunications and Broadcasting is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission | Conseil de la radiodiffusion et des télécommunications canadiennes. This publication gives an overview of the communications industry from 2013 to 2017, and highlights pertinent revenue trends and key industry characteristics. The communications industry encompasses both the broadcasting and telecommunications market sectors. The data presented comes from CRTC sources. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission | Conseil de la radiodiffusion et des télécommunications canadiennes. Its tags are Télécommunications, Radiodiffusion, Rapport, Statistiques, Service téléphonique. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX, XLSX. The portal shows 2018-12-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
